LESSON: PHONOLOGICAL AWARENESS

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Listening and Speaking
Topic 1.2: Phonological Awareness

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Phonological Awareness
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: What strategies can you use to apply new words effectively?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. apply vocabulary acquired in forming sentences
2. appreciate the different sounds and patterns in a language

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)
